chunks: And from his sermon (peace be upon him) concerning the Greatest Messenger (peace be upon him and his family) and the Imam's conveyance of it from him.

key_terms.الرَّسُولِ الْأَعْرَضِ: The Greatest Messenger (referring to Prophet Muhammad SAWW)

ai.seo_question: What is the context of Imam Ali's sermon regarding the Holy Prophet in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This heading introduces a sermon from Nahj al-Balagha, compiled by Sharif al-Radi, where Imam Ali (peace be upon him) elucidates the Prophet's role as the ultimate conveyer of divine revelation. It highlights the theological concept of *balagh* (delivery), emphasizing the Imam's authority in interpreting and transmitting the Prophet's message to the community. This context underscores the continuity of leadership and guidance from the Prophet to the Imams in Shia tradition.
